observations: Photo 0 shows a white and grey photocopier with the lid open, revealing the glass document feeder and control panel. The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-5516' are visible on the front panel.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with the lid open, revealing the document feeder and control panel. The machine appears to be in a room with tiled flooring and visible wear on the casing.
Photo 2 shows the machine from a different angle, with the lid open, revealing the document feeder and control panel. The machine has visible dust and grime, especially on the lid and casing.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEIMOS INC'.
The machine appears to be a used photocopier, with no visible damage to the main body, but signs of wear and dust on the lid and casing.

claims.claim: Selling a Sharp AR-5516 Digital Photocopier
claims.evidence: The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-5516' are clearly visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 2.

claims.claim: ideal for office use, business centers, cybercafes
claims.evidence: This is a subjective claim about suitability; no evidence in photos to verify or contradict it.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, scanning, and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The machine may have a damaged or missing toner cartridge or drum.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and drum, or a video showing the machine printing a test page.

risks.risk: The machine may have mechanical issues such as a jammed paper feed or clogged fuser.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine feeding a test page and fusing a test page.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge and drum.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
